page.overview:
What is Skorupi?

Skorupi is based on a scorpion, hence its Pokémon species name, and it's been colored purple. While its shiny color is red.

Skorupi prefers living in more arid environments, hiding in the sand and can wait up to a whole year for prey to come its way, or to eat something. When it does find prey, it will grab onto them with its claws and tail, holding on vigorously and leaving them unable to move as the poison it injects from the tip of its tail takes effect.

It also shares a common descent with Sizzlipede from the Galar region.

Skorupi evolves into Drapion starting at level 40.
